source_title: ARSD 20:06:06:03, Credit life insurance -- Acceptable rates (South Dakota Legislature, Administrative Rules)
plan: Single premium decreasing term, single life
basis: per year for each $100 of initial insured indebtedness
rate_table_note: Rates are in 20:06:06:03(1) and (2); the monthly rate is stated as the actuarial equivalent of the single premium decreasing rate. Joint credit life is at most 1.5 times single (20:06:06:03.03); not published as a figure. 20:06:06:02 makes these the prima facie acceptable rates.
summary: Rates in force: South Dakota's acceptable credit life rates in ARSD 20:06:06:03: $.56 per year per $100 single premium decreasing term ($.88 per month per $1,000 outstanding as its equivalent) and $1.02 per year per $100 level term. The rule was last amended by 26 SDR 150, adopted May 21, 2000, effective July 1, 2000; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked, so July 1, 2000 is the date the current text took effect.

source_title: ARSD 20:06:06:04, Credit health insurance -- Acceptable rates (South Dakota Legislature, Administrative Rules)
rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in 20:06:06:04(1), by number of months in which the indebtedness is repayable (bands of three months, 6 or less to 118-120) and 14- or 30-day, nonretroactive or retroactive benefits; the 10-12 and 58-60 bands are recorded. Joint credit disability is at most 1.75 times single (20:06:06:04.04).
summary: Rates in force: South Dakota's acceptable single premium credit health rates in ARSD 20:06:06:04, per $100 of initial insured indebtedness, for 10-12 and 58-60 months, 14- and 30-day, nonretroactive and retroactive. The rule was last amended by 26 SDR 150, adopted May 21, 2000, effective July 1, 2000; whether that amendment changed these figures was not checked, so July 1, 2000 is the date the current text took effect.
